description: Read LinkedIn company pages as a logged out visitor sees them. Takes company URLs or slugs and returns one row per company with industry, size band, employees on LinkedIn, followers, website, headquarters, type, founded, specialties, About text, similar companies, and recent posts.

companies.description: LinkedIn company page URLs (https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe), or slugs (stripe). Showcase pages work too. Numeric company IDs are not readable without a login and come back as free rows. Each company is read once per run. From Clay, wrap a column in a one item list.

include_recent_posts.description: yes (default) adds the recent posts the public page shows, as a JSON list of url, date, text, and likes. Free; no extra request.

include_similar_pages.description: yes (default) adds the similar companies LinkedIn shows, as a JSON list. Free; no extra request.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Free rows are always returned.

max_companies.description: Optional. Read at most this many companies from the list. Default and maximum 5000.

name: get_linkedin_company_details
title: Get LinkedIn company details
